VomTag.posture_description: Greatsword held high above the right shoulder or directly overhead, blade angled steeply upward. Maximum potential gravitational energy.
VomTag.tactical_purpose: Dominates high lines. Threatens massive downward vertical and diagonal cleaves.
vulnerabilities: Vulnerable to rapid horizontal thwart cuts (Zwerchhau)

Ochs.posture_description: Hands held high near the temples with the point directed at the opponent's face and eyes. Quillons form an angled protective roof.
Ochs.tactical_purpose: Threatens high plunging thrusts while providing strong upper parrying geometry.
vulnerabilities: Hands and wrists are exposed to off-axis strikes (Krumphau)
Lower body openings below the quillons

Pflug.posture_description: Hilt held at the hip, thumb resting against the blade flat, point angled forward toward the opponent's throat/chest.
Pflug.tactical_purpose: Fast upward thrusts from below the opponent's line of sight; exceptional defensive leverage.
vulnerabilities: Vulnerable to deceptive plunging false-edge counter cuts (Schielhau)
Overhead crown strikes (Scheitelhau) if point dips

Alber.posture_description: Blade point resting low near the ground, arms extended downward, presenting an apparent opening to bait enemy overextension.
Alber.tactical_purpose: Deceptive baiting stance. Lures enemies into attacking the exposed head, enabling explosive rising parries and counter-thrusts.
vulnerabilities: Directly vulnerable to maximum-reach vertical crown cuts (Scheitelhau) that crush the blade before it lifts

Mordhau.posture_description: Inverted grip with both gauntleted hands grasping the mid-blade (half-swording), utilizing crossguard quillons and pommel as a war hammer.
Mordhau.tactical_purpose: Transforms the sword into a devastating blunt concussive polearm designed to shatter rigid plate armor and heavy shields.
vulnerabilities: Severely reduced striking reach compared to long edge cleaves

Langort.posture_description: Arms fully extended with point fixed dead center on the opponent's throat. Terminal endpoint for all thrusts.
Langort.tactical_purpose: Establishes an impassable barrier of distance; forces the enemy to step off-line or attempt to displace the blade.
vulnerabilities: Susceptible to lateral blade beating and side-steps
